support.helpSub: Who to ask, and how to reach us.
support.askAccountantMeta: For anything about your books, reports or requests
support.emailUsMeta: For a problem with the app itself: {{email}}
support.notFoundBody: The link you followed leads nowhere in the app. It may be old, or mistyped.
support.errorBody: This screen could not be shown. Try again, and if it keeps happening, close the app and open it again.
support.aiWhatBody: Your questions to the AI advisor, the receipts you photograph so they can be read for you, and the figures of your business needed to answer.
support.aiWhereBody: To Anthropic, the company behind the Claude AI service. If you record a question, the recording goes to OpenAI to be turned into text. Both are outside Mizan.
support.aiWorthBody: Written by a machine. They can be wrong. They are not accounting, tax or legal advice. Nothing is entered in your books unless a person approves it.
support.aiChoiceBody: You can use the rest of the app without AI: receipts can be filled in by hand. You can withdraw your agreement in Settings at any time.
support.aiSaveFailed: Your choice could not be saved. Please try again.
support.aiWithdrawBody: The app will ask for your agreement again before it uses AI for you.
support.deleteGoesBody: Your sign-in, your profile and your access to this company in the app.
support.deleteStaysBody: Your company's accounting records. The law requires them to be kept for a set period, so your accountant keeps them. They are not deleted with your account.
support.deleteAfterBody: The request goes to Mizan and to your accountant. It cannot be undone once it is carried out. If you only want to stop using the app, you can sign out instead.
support.deleteConfirmBody: Your request will be sent now.
support.deleteFailed: The request could not be sent. Try again, or ask by email instead.
support.deleteSentBody: Your request to delete your account has been recorded. You will be told by email when it has been carried out.
support.deleteByEmailBody: To delete your account, write to {{email}} from the email address you sign in with. We will confirm and carry it out.
